WITH matched AS (
	 SELECT c.model,c.provider,c.metric_kind,c.currency,c.usage_date,g.period,c.token_count,c.cost_count,c.rate_missing
 FROM usage_daily_summaries c JOIN usage_report_utc_calendar g ON g.utc_date=c.usage_date
 WHERE  c.scope_id=? AND c.generation=? AND c.calendar='UTC' AND g.full_month=1
), edge_matched AS (
	 SELECT c.model,c.provider,substr(local.period,1,7)||'-01' AS period,c.metric_kind,c.currency,c.usage_date,c.rate_tokens
	 FROM usage_projection_contributions c
	 JOIN usage_projection_applied a ON a.scope_id=c.scope_id AND a.generation=c.generation AND a.work_key=c.work_key AND a.build_id=c.build_id
	 JOIN usage_report_utc_calendar u ON u.utc_date=c.usage_date AND u.full_month=0
	 JOIN usage_report_calendar local ON c.coverage_start>=local.start_at AND c.coverage_start<local.end_at
	 WHERE c.calendar='UTC' AND c.coverage_kind='point' AND c.coverage_start>=u.start_at AND c.coverage_start<u.end_at AND  c.scope_id=? AND c.generation=?
), currencies AS (
	 SELECT model,provider,period,currency FROM matched WHERE metric_kind='cost'
	 UNION ALL
	 SELECT model,provider,period,currency FROM edge_matched WHERE metric_kind='cost'
), monthly AS (
	 SELECT model,provider,period,COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(currency,'')) AS currencies
	 FROM currencies GROUP BY model,provider,period
), daily AS (
 SELECT model,provider,period,usage_date,
 SUM(CASE WHEN metric_kind='tokens' THEN token_count ELSE 0 END) AS tokens,
 SUM(CASE WHEN metric_kind='cost' THEN cost_count ELSE 0 END) AS costs,
 SUM(CASE WHEN metric_kind='cost' AND NULLIF(currency,'') IS NULL THEN cost_count ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_costs,
	 SUM(CASE WHEN metric_kind='cost' THEN rate_missing ELSE 0 END) AS rate_missing,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metric_kind='cost' THEN NULLIF(currency,'') END) AS currencies
 FROM matched GROUP BY model,provider,period,usage_date
	), edge_daily AS (
	 SELECT model,provider,period,usage_date,
	 SUM(CASE WHEN metric_kind='tokens' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tokens,
	 SUM(CASE WHEN metric_kind='cost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costs,
	 SUM(CASE WHEN metric_kind='cost' AND NULLIF(currency,'') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_costs,
	 SUM(CASE WHEN metric_kind='cost' AND rate_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rate_missing,
	 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metric_kind='cost' THEN NULLIF(currency,'') END) AS currencies
	 FROM edge_matched GROUP BY model,provider,period,usage_date
)

UPDATE usage_report_utc_month_dimensions SET summarize=0 WHERE EXISTS (
	 SELECT 1 FROM monthly m WHERE m.model=usage_report_utc_month_dimensions.model
	 AND m.provider=usage_report_utc_month_dimensions.provider AND m.period=usage_report_utc_month_dimensions.period
	 AND m.currencies>1) OR EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM daily d JOIN monthly m
 ON m.model=d.model AND m.provider=d.provider AND m.period=d.period
 WHERE d.model=usage_report_utc_month_dimensions.model AND d.provider=usage_report_utc_month_dimensions.provider
 AND d.period=usage_report_utc_month_dimensions.period AND m.currencies=1 AND d.tokens>0
		 AND (d.currencies=0 OR d.unknown_costs>0 OR d.tokens>d.costs OR d.rate_missing>0)) OR EXISTS (
	 SELECT 1 FROM edge_daily d JOIN monthly m
	 ON m.model=d.model AND m.provider=d.provider AND m.period=d.period
	 WHERE d.model=usage_report_utc_month_dimensions.model AND d.provider=usage_report_utc_month_dimensions.provider
	 AND d.period=usage_report_utc_month_dimensions.period AND m.currencies=1 AND d.tokens>0
		 AND (d.currencies=0 OR d.unknown_costs>0 OR d.tokens>d.costs OR d.rate_missing>0))

AS calendar,'requested' AS calendar_basis,c.metric_kind,c.actor_id,c.actor_status,c.actor_kind,c.source,c.model,c.provider,c.agent_client,c.semantics,c.currency,c.input_tokens,c.output_tokens,c.cache_read_tokens,c.cache_write_tokens,c.reasoning_tokens,c.total_tokens,c.source_total_tokens,c.turns,c.cost_subcents,c.rate_tokens,c.input_missing,c.output_missing,c.cache_read_missing,c.cache_write_missing,c.reasoning_missing,c.total_missing,c.source_total_missing,c.turns_missing,c.cost_missing,c.rate_missing,c.token_count,c.cost_count,c.partial_count+CASE WHEN g.month_partial=1 THEN c.token_count+c.cost_count ELSE 0 END AS partial_count,c.estimated_count,c.stale_count,c.cost_basis FROM usage_daily_summaries c JOIN usage_report_utc_calendar g ON g.utc_date=c.usage_date AND g.full_month=1 JOIN usage_report_utc_month_dimensions d ON d.model=c.model AND d.provider=c.provider AND d.period=g.period AND d.summarize=1 WHERE  c.scope_id=? AND c.generation=? AND c.calendar='UTC' UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(u.subject_id,'') AS subject_id,COALESCE(u.task_id,'') AS task_id,COALESCE(u.task_incarnation_id,'') AS task_incarnation_id,COALESCE(u.session_id,'') AS session_id,COALESCE(u.session_incarnation_id,'') AS session_incarnation_id,f.work_key,f.segment_key,f.bundle_key,f.coverage_kind,g.period,? AS calendar,'requested' AS calendar_basis,c.metric_kind,c.actor_id,c.actor_status,c.actor_kind,c.source,c.model,c.provider,c.agent_client,c.semantics,c.currency,c.input_tokens,c.output_tokens,c.cache_read_tokens,c.cache_write_tokens,c.reasoning_tokens,c.total_tokens,c.source_total_tokens,c.turns,c.cost_subcents,c.rate_tokens,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.input_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS input_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.output_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS output_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.cache_read_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cache_read_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.cache_write_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cache_write_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.reasoning_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reasoning_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.total_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS total_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.source_total_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS source_total_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.turns IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS turns_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'cost' AND c.cost_subcents IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cost_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'cost' AND c.rate_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rate_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS token_count,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'cost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cost_count,CASE WHEN c.partial <> 0 OR (g.month_partial=1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS partial_count,c.estimated AS estimated_count,c.stale AS stale_count,c.cost_basis FROM (WITH edge_days AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT start_at,end_at FROM usage_report_utc_calendar WHERE full_month=0
) SELECT * FROM edge_days) d CROSS JOIN usage_projection_contributions c CROSS JOIN usage_projection_applied a CROSS JOIN usage_canonical_facts f
 LEFT JOIN usage_subjects u ON u.scope_id=f.scope_id AND u.subject_id=f.subject_id  JOIN usage_report_calendar g ON g.start_at=(SELECT start_at FROM usage_report_calendar WHERE start_at<=c.coverage_start ORDER BY start_at DESC LIMIT 1) AND c.coverage_start<g.end_at WHERE c.calendar='UTC' AND c.coverage_kind='point' AND c.coverage_start>=d.start_at AND c.coverage_start<d.end_at AND  c.scope_id=? AND c.generation=? AND a.scope_id=f.scope_id AND a.generation=f.generation AND a.work_key=f.work_key AND a.build_id=f.build_id
 AND c.scope_id=f.scope_id AND c.generation=f.generation AND c.build_id=f.build_id AND c.fact_key=f.fact_key UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(u.subject_id,'') AS subject_id,COALESCE(u.task_id,'') AS task_id,COALESCE(u.task_incarnation_id,'') AS task_incarnation_id,COALESCE(u.session_id,'') AS session_id,COALESCE(u.session_incarnation_id,'') AS session_incarnation_id,f.work_key,f.segment_key,f.bundle_key,f.coverage_kind,g.period,? AS calendar,'requested' AS calendar_basis,c.metric_kind,c.actor_id,c.actor_status,c.actor_kind,c.source,c.model,c.provider,c.agent_client,c.semantics,c.currency,c.input_tokens,c.output_tokens,c.cache_read_tokens,c.cache_write_tokens,c.reasoning_tokens,c.total_tokens,c.source_total_tokens,c.turns,c.cost_subcents,c.rate_tokens,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.input_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS input_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.output_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS output_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.cache_read_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cache_read_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.cache_write_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cache_write_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.reasoning_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reasoning_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.total_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS total_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.source_total_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS source_total_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' AND c.turns IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS turns_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'cost' AND c.cost_subcents IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cost_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'cost' AND c.rate_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rate_missing,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'tokens' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS token_count,CASE WHEN c.metric_kind = 'cost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cost_count,CASE WHEN c.partial <> 0 OR (g.month_partial=1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS partial_count,c.estimated AS estimated_count,c.stale AS stale_count,c.cost_basis FROM (WITH fallback_days AS MATERIALIZED (

 JOIN usage_report_utc_month_dimensions x ON x.period=d.period AND x.summarize=0 WHERE d.full_month=1
